title: feat(connector-slack): make ConnectorSlackPlugin's static bot token optional
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7rHCNuVSmroKh1hDHw61rk)_

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：只用各组织自己 Slack 令牌发私信的部署，装 Slack 插件时不必再填一个占位的机器人令牌；不填时启动日志说一句「流程里的 Slack 连接器没注册」，填了则一切照旧。
- 为什么做：Slack 私信渠道（替各组织用自己的令牌给成员发 Slack 私信）上线后留下的收尾，插件的令牌只给流程连接器用，私信用不到。
- 出错会怎样：没填令牌的部署里，流程若引用 Slack 连接器，会和没装插件时一样执行失败；填了令牌的部署行为不变，可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `ConnectorSlackPluginOptions` is now `Omit<SlackConnectorOptions, 'token'>` plus `token?: string`, and the constructor's options argument is optional.
- `start()`: without a token (absent or empty string) the plugin logs one info line (`no static bot token — flow Slack connector not registered; the 'slack' client service serves caller-held tokens only`) and returns before touching the automation engine. With a token it registers the `slack` flow connector exactly as before.
- `init()` is unchanged: the `slack` client service (`createSlackClientService`, already token-free since #35789) is registered in both compositions.
- `SlackConnectorOptions.token` and `createSlackConnector` are unchanged: the connector itself still requires a token.

## Tests

`packages/connectors/connector-slack/src/connector-slack-plugin.test.ts`, new block "composed without a static bot token":

- Kernel composition with `{ fetchImpl }` only: the automation engine is up (`connector_action` registered, positive control) and has no `slack` connector; the `slack` client service sends with the caller's token.
- Kernel composition with `new ConnectorSlackPlugin()`: boots, no connector, client service present.
- Harness context, token omitted and token `''`: exactly one info line, the registry's `registerConnector` never called, `destroy()` a no-op.
- Same harness with a token: the connector is registered (control for the skip).

The existing token-ful tests (end-to-end flow post, client service, shutdown unregister) are unchanged and green, which pins the "with a token, unchanged" half.

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-② measured on the built declaration: `packages/connectors/connector-slack/dist/index.d.ts` exports `type ConnectorSlackPluginOptions` from the package entry (`exports["."]`, `files: ["dist", …]`), now spelled `interface ConnectorSlackPluginOptions extends Omit<SlackConnectorOptions, 'token'> { token?: string; }` and `constructor(options?: ConnectorSlackPluginOptions)`. Published surface, widened only: every value accepted before is still accepted. Hence `yes (widening)`; it owes the seat's TIER_DEFAULT review of the declaration.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: a plugin constructor option, not stored metadata. Kind `none` ⇒ `patch`.
- An empty-string token is read as absent, so a deployment wiring an unset environment value through as `""` gets the skip and its log line rather than a connector that fails every call with `not_authed`.
- No other in-repo composition passes a tokenless option today (runtime and service-messaging composition tests all pass a token), so no consumer changes.
